summary.intent: Execute plan 48-03 (REQ-3 SDK side) to implement shared-folder state management in the cipher-box SDK, then kick off 48-05 (REQ-4 API) for the M1 security fix.
summary.outcome: 48-03 completed successfully: SharedFolderTree, 5 client shared-write methods, and sharedFolder:updated event landed with 23 passing tests and a clean sdk suite. 48-05 was queued and running at transcript end.

repo: SharedFolderTree is keyed by shareId (NOT ipnsName) — two shares with the same ipnsName remain isolated (T-48-07)
The sdk package has no 'typecheck' npm script; tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json is the correct equivalent
integration.test.ts failures (ECONNREFUSED:3000) are pre-existing and require a running server — not a regression indicator
The pre-commit hook enforces that the regenerated API client (pnpm api:generate output) must be committed alongside migration changes
updateSharedFile emits sharedFolder:updated with unchanged children/sequence because the stateless function returns void and only publishes file IPNS metadata

code.finding: SharedFolderTree: sibling map keyed by shareId with get/set/has/delete/clear/getAll; set() clones folderKey/ipnsPrivateKey; delete()/clear() zero key material (T-48-06)

New shared-folder client methods all follow (shareId, args) signature: loadSharedFolder, hasSharedFolder, getSharedFolderState, unloadSharedFolder, uploadToSharedFolder, createSharedSubfolder, renameInSharedFolder, deleteFromSharedFolder, updateSharedFile — each reads state, builds SharedWriteContext, delegates to stateless share/shared-write.ts (no second retry loop, T-48-08), writes back, emits event
sharedFolder:updated event shape: { type: 'sharedFolder:updated'; shareId; ipnsName; children; sequenceNumber }

workflow: Plan execution used Opus model for crypto/migration-sensitive work (48-05) and standard model for SDK state work (48-03)
Wave sequencing: 48-02 → 48-03 → 48-05 → 48-04 → 48-06 → full web-e2e + reviews + re-sign + PR
TDD RED/GREEN gate pattern enforced across tasks: Task 2 lands failing tests, Task 3 makes them pass
Signed commits used throughout; each task gets its own commit for traceability
